en: Black‑and‑white image of a long, austere four‑ to five‑story institutional building in a neo‑Renaissance / fortress style, with a crenellated roofline and evenly spaced windows. The façade faces a broad, nearly empty street with a sidewalk lined by small trimmed trees and a low fence. A few pedestrians walk along the street and there is a grassy area with simple fencing in the foreground. The image has the framing and composition typical of an early 20th‑century architectural postcard.
